boundaries.evidenceTest: failed Approval cannot partially advance Plan, Proposal, or accepted ledger state
boundaries.invariant: A rejected command leaves accepted Plan, Proposal, and accepted ledger state unchanged.

boundaries.evidenceTest: bounded geometry fuzzing fails closed without altering the canonical fixture
boundaries.invariant: Invalid geometry cannot alter the canonical Plan fixture.

boundaries.evidenceTest: planner denies insufficient roles without changing Plan truth and records sanitized evidence
boundaries.invariant: Authorization denial records safe evidence without changing accepted Plan truth.

boundaries.evidenceTest: bounded tool-input fuzzing rejects malformed editor commands before accepted or proposed state changes
boundaries.invariant: Malformed generated-contract inputs fail before accepted or proposed state changes.

boundaries.evidenceTest: WebMCP resource limits reject oversized fuzz payloads before planner mutation
boundaries.invariant: Rejected WebMCP calls do not reach the Planner mutation boundary.

boundaries.evidenceTest: stdio MCP is a black box with schema rejection and no partial Project mutation
boundaries.invariant: Rejected stdio MCP calls leave the Project byte-equivalent.

boundaries.evidenceTest: overlapping stale planning edits fail visibly and preserve local recovery state
boundaries.invariant: A remote conflict cannot erase or silently commit the local recovery branch.

boundaries.evidenceTest: Worker rejects API JSON resource overruns with stable safe 413 metadata before repositories
boundaries.invariant: Invalid HTTP input is rejected before any repository call.

boundaries.evidenceTest: an injected second-statement failure rolls back the entire Project write
boundaries.invariant: A failed D1 batch leaves Project metadata and snapshot rows unchanged.

boundaries.evidenceTest: Runbook idempotency conflicts and stale batches leave every durable surface unchanged
boundaries.invariant: Rejected Runbook batches leave projection, receipt, transition, and ledger rows unchanged.

boundaries.evidenceTest: exact retries are duplicate-safe while stale revisions and source rollback fail
boundaries.invariant: Rejected occupancy signals leave the immutable Monitor input unchanged.

boundaries.evidenceTest: Incident Register writes advance exactly one revision and reject stale or baseline-changing updates
boundaries.invariant: Rejected Incident writes leave the authoritative register unchanged.

boundaries.evidenceTest: Deviation repository advances exactly one revision and rejects stale or baseline-changing writes
boundaries.invariant: Rejected Deviation writes leave the authoritative register unchanged.

boundaries.evidenceTest: repository conditionally advances one verified revision and rejects stale or changed baselines
boundaries.invariant: Rejected Post-event Review writes leave the authoritative review unchanged.

boundaries.evidenceTest: durable cursor detects a pruned missed event and resumes in order
boundaries.invariant: A missed collaboration chain forces authoritative recovery instead of synthesizing accepted state.

boundaries.evidenceTest: ledgered create and revoke operations recover when repository finalization fails
boundaries.invariant: A partial Share operation remains pending and reconciles exactly once.

boundaries.evidenceTest: Import Preview rejects malformed geometry, duplicate stable IDs, and locked Proposal mutations
boundaries.invariant: Rejected packages never cross the pure Import Preview boundary.

boundaries.evidenceTest: adapter review rejects a stale base object checksum without changing accepted Plan or Proposal state
boundaries.invariant: Rejected adapter staging cannot mutate accepted Plan or Proposal state.

boundaries.evidenceTest: webhook delivery is idempotent and altered replay is rejected
boundaries.invariant: An altered webhook retry cannot replace its durable receipt or processed result.

boundaries.evidenceTest: incompatible resources do not become substitution options
boundaries.invariant: Incompatible operational supply remains evidence and cannot become a Planning Change.
